name: Sei ANG Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap ETF
name_en: Sei ANG Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap ETF
desc: The fund seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, track the total return performance of the iSTOXX Ang Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Index (the "underlying index"), which is a rules-based equity index provided by STOXX Ltd. (the "index provider" or "STOXX"). It uses a "passive" or indexing approach to try to achieve its investment objective. It invests at least 80% of its total assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
index: STOXX Ang Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Index
